note: No queryable zoning district service found for Miller County GA or its seat, the City of Colquitt. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches return no Miller County zoning layer. The county website links only to a qPublic/Beacon property records viewer. The 2007 community agenda says the unincorporated county had no comprehensive land use regulations. Colquitt has a 1998 zoning ordinance (10 districts) and publishes rezoning notices, but no GIS layer or map service was found; the regional commission's Colquitt page was unreachable (HTTP 520).
